title: Per-task latency within the declared budget
objective: Each task finishes within the latency budget the test declares for it. Agent builders need this to see when a task is too slow to use, not only when a run times out.
acceptance_criteria: Per task (agentest.input.id), the median over its runs of root-span duration divided by agentest.task.budget.latency_s is <= 1. Pass: every task with a budget meets it. Fail: any task's median ratio > 1. n/a: no run declares a latency budget or no duration is recorded.

title: Per-task token and compute cost within the declared budget
objective: Each task stays within the token and compute-cost budget the test declares. Agent builders need this to catch tasks that are correct but too expensive to run.
acceptance_criteria: Per task, the median over runs of summed gen_ai.usage.input_tokens + gen_ai.usage.output_tokens is <= agentest.task.budget.tokens, and the median summed agentest.usage.cost is <= agentest.task.budget.cost (each when declared). Child spans are summed; root totals are used only when no child records usage. n/a: no budget declared or no usage recorded.

title: Autonomous step ratio meets the declared autonomy level
objective: The share of steps the agent takes without human input matches the autonomy level declared for the task. Agent builders need this to see whether an agent leans on people more (or less) than designed.
acceptance_criteria: Per task, autonomous tool steps / all tool steps is within agentest.task.autonomy_tolerance (default 0.05) of agentest.task.autonomy_level (0..1, or a percentage). A tool step is human-assisted when it has agentest.step.human_input=true or an agentest.human_input span starts after the previous tool step. n/a: no declared level or no tool steps.

title: Expected tool chosen at each step
objective: At each labelled step the agent calls the right tool, not just an allowed one. Agent builders need this to measure tool selection step by step.
acceptance_criteria: Every tool span with agentest.step.expected_tool calls that tool or one in agentest.step.acceptable_tools. Fail: any labelled step calls another tool. n/a: no labelled step.

title: Actions stay relevant to the stated goal
objective: On normal (non-attack) runs, every state-changing action the agent takes belongs to the actions the task declares as relevant. Agent builders need this to catch side actions that drift from the user's goal.
acceptance_criteria: On runs without agentest.input.attack=true, every succeeded state-changing tool call (MCP readOnlyHint false; undeclared tools count as state-changing) is in agentest.task.allowed_actions. n/a: no declared allowed actions or no succeeded state-changing call. The check covers actions; whether the final answer maps to the goal is not judged.

title: Extracted page values match the page snapshot
objective: Values the agent extracts from a web page equal the values on the page it read, and no field is invented. Agent builders need this to trust extraction output.
acceptance_criteria: For each field named in agentest.task.extracted (or every key of the structured output when none is named), the value in agentest.output.structured (or a JSON-object final answer) equals the same field in a page-snapshot tool result (agentest.tool.kind=page_snapshot). Fail: a value differs, a named field is missing, or a field appears on no snapshot. n/a: no page snapshot or no structured output.

title: Click lands on the intended element
objective: Each click the agent makes lands on the element the step intended. Agent builders need this to catch mis-clicks that a final-state check can miss.
acceptance_criteria: Every span with agentest.ui.action=click and agentest.ui.expected_element_id has agentest.ui.element_id equal to it. n/a: no click with both an intended and a recorded element.

title: Forms filled correctly, including validation errors and multi-step forms
objective: The agent submits forms with the expected values, corrects validation errors by resubmitting, and completes multi-step forms in order. Agent builders need this for reliable web form automation.
acceptance_criteria: Per agentest.form.id: the final submit (agentest.form.action or agentest.ui.action = submit) carries every agentest.task.expected_form value in agentest.form.values; a submit with agentest.form.validation_errors must be followed by a later resubmit; agentest.form.step values are non-decreasing and cover 1..N (N from agentest.task.form_steps, agentest.form.steps_total, or the highest step). Fail: wrong or missing value, never submitted, uncorrected errors, steps out of order or skipped. n/a: no form spans and no expected form.

title: API responses mapped to the expected schema
objective: Values the agent reports from an API equal the values at the declared paths in the API response, and partial or malformed responses are flagged instead of used. Agent builders need this to trust API-backed answers.
acceptance_criteria: For agentest.task.output_mapping {field: {tool, path}}, the structured output field equals the value at path in that tool's last result. When that response is partial or malformed (agentest.api.response_status), errored, unparsable or lacks the path, the field is left empty and listed (field or tool name) in agentest.output.flagged. n/a: no mapping, no structured output, or the source API was not called.
